name: rosetta-exponentiation-operator
code:
use default

**(base: int, exponent: int) -> int =>
    (1::exponent) |> reduce(1, (result, _) => result * base)

**(base: double, exponent: int) -> double =>
    (1::exponent) |> reduce(1.0, (result, _) => result * base)

power(base: int, exponent: int) -> int => base ** exponent
power(base: double, exponent: int) -> double => base ** exponent

write_line("2 ** 10 = {2 ** 10}")
write_line("2.5 ** 3 = {2.5 ** 3}")
write_line("power(3, 4) = {power(3, 4)}")
write_line("power(1.5, 2) = {power(1.5, 2)}")
